title: Simultaneous Sleep Stage and Sleep Disorder Detection from Multimodal Sensors Using Deep Learning.
summary: A source-described retrospective sleep-diagnostic study fuses EEG, ECG and EMG CNN outputs with a shallow neural network to recognize six sleep stages and eight disorder labels in the PhysioNet CAP Sleep database. The paper reports 94.34% sleep-stage and 99.09% disorder accuracy. Scope is a closed-set sample split: the same patient groups appear in train and test, so it does not establish performance on unseen patients.
